SHOP PROMISE AND THE VALUE ENGINE | G2 / G4-G6
Merchant promise -> buyer confidence -> more merchant sales
|
+-- Intended mechanism
|   [S] Reliable delivery timing should improve buyer confidence.
|   Confidence -[D:claim]-> conversion.
|   [I] More merchant sales could increase paid service usage.
|   Merchant sales -[D:claim]-> Shopify revenue.
|
+-- Management's evidence before the sale
|   [S] Q2 2022: >30% conversion uplift suggested by Deliverr data
|       for many merchants as Shop Promise reaches scale.
|   [S] Q3 2022: participating merchants saw up to 9% uplift.
|   [S] Q4 2022: merchants in the program saw up to 25% uplift.
|   [I] Forecast, changing cohorts and maxima are not comparable averages.
|   Badge adoption -[D:assoc]-> reported conversion uplift.
|   [I] No controlled causal test is supplied.
|
+-- Delivery measures also changed
|   [S] Q2 2022: predicted <=2-day orders rose from <2% to >70%.
|   [S] September 2022: >two-thirds delivered within two business days.
|   [I] Predicted and delivered performance are different measures.
|
`-- Post-sale promise definition
    [R] FY2023: verified reliable delivery in <=5 calendar days.
    [R] Flexport designated preferred Shop Promise provider.
    [I] Two-day offer versus five-day eligibility is not proof of slowdown.
Evidence: V1-V3. Outcome continuity after the sale is untestable.
